properties.decision: The release matrix builds linux-x86_64 (ELF) and macos arm64/x86_64 (Mach-O); on Windows the installer refuses with "build from source". Adding a windows-x86_64 target is mostly CI configuration, but RocksDB's C++ build on Windows is the unknown that can cost a day, and a target in the matrix is a promise that has to be kept green on every release. No user has asked. Anthony, 2026-09-12: go with the recommendation — not until someone on Windows asks. The trigger is a request from a Windows user, at which point this decision is superseded and the target is added.
properties.name: A Windows (PE) build of reflow2-mcp waits until someone on Windows asks for it
properties.rationale: Raised by Anthony's question about executable formats (PE / ELF / Mach-O) on 2026-09-12 while the local profile moved to a release binary (increment 430). Recorded so the absence of a Windows target reads as a choice with a trigger rather than an oversight.
